edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] with the caller address as spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
acceptOwnership authorizes based on the equality of msg.sender and newOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner and sweeps tokens to the caller-controlled owner path.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowed allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping for the spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external callback.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply into the balances mapping.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner state variable.
transfer invokes safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balances and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
safeAdd performs an unchecked-at-compile-time addition that can overflow.
safeSub performs a subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul multiplies and verifies the result by division.
safeDiv divides after requiring a non-zero denominator.
approveAndCall performs an external callback to the spender-controlled contract, enabling reentrancy into token state.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract whose transfer implementation may reenter.

_newOwner is written into newOwner only inside transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is only used as a lookup key inside balanceOf.
The balance return value belongs to the balanceOf function scope.
Recipient address is only used inside the transfer function.
Token amount is only used inside the transfer function.
The success boolean is a trivial return value of transfer.
spender is only used to index allowed inside approve.
tokens is only used as the allowance value inside approve.
from is only used inside transferFrom for balance and allowance debits.
to is only used inside transferFrom for the balance credit.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key inside allowance.
spender is only a lookup key inside allowance.
remaining is the direct return value of allowance.
spender is used as allowance key and callback target inside approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance amount of approveAndCall.
The data blob is only forwarded through the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount forwarded in the external ERC20 transfer.
